description: This file defines the UserRepository interface extending JpaRepository for User entity, including custom query methods for finding by username and checking existence by username and email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for User entity, extending JpaRepository with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Finds a user by their username, returning an Optional<User>.

methods.name: existsByUsername
methods.description: Checks if a user exists with the specified username.

methods.name: existsByEmail
methods.description: Checks if a user exists with the specified email.
